title: Ferdinand Georg Frobenius: Group Character Papers, German Source and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Frobenius record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record holds source-witnessed German LaTeX transcriptions, English translation working drafts, cumulative readers, scans, and audit ledgers for selected Frobenius group-character papers.

Initial dedicated update. Publishes Frobenius_all_GE_EN_cum_scans_QA03_20260611.zip. The package status reports all completed selected group-character items included: 10/10 completed items, previously tracked source-intake pages 221/221, German all-author cumulative 182 generated pages, English all-author cumulative 176 generated pages, and 241 cumulative source-scan pages merged. It includes per-work folders, cumulative German/English material, source scans, manifests, completeness audits, build-status notes, visible-text checks, and translation-alignment ledgers.

Quality note. This is a source-witnessed working-draft package, not a certified critical edition. Source scans and audit ledgers are the authority; OCR/text extraction is only a locator and comparison aid. Verify important formulas, notation, theorem statements, and references against the included source witnesses.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
